Test Objective: Confirm scope and payment data flows
Procedure: Interview process owners; inspect payment flow diagrams, system inventories, network paths and provider responsibilities; reconcile with the actual approved environment.
Expected Result: Scope statement identifies payment channels, CDE components, connected/impacting systems and relevant third parties.
Exception Criteria: Unexplained asset or data flow, outdated diagram, or unsupported scope exclusion.
Evidence to Retain: Approved scope statement, redacted diagrams, inventory reconciliation notes

Procedure: Inspect relevant network/security control configurations, approved flows, change tickets and periodic reviews; sample rules.
Expected Result: Rules are aligned to documented business need, authorized and reviewed as required.
Exception Criteria: Unjustified access, missing required review, or unsupported rule exception.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted configuration, sample and review results

Procedure: Sample in-scope components and compare configuration evidence with approved hardening standards and exception records.
Expected Result: Sampled configurations meet applicable baselines or deviations are tracked and approved.
Exception Criteria: Material deviation without remediation or authorized exception.
Evidence to Retain: Baseline, redacted sample exports and gap references

Procedure: Confirm whether account data is stored; review approved data discovery, retention and protection evidence. Do not collect live PAN or sensitive authentication data.
Expected Result: Storage and retention are known and controls meet applicable requirements.
Exception Criteria: Unapproved or prohibited storage, unexplained retention, or insufficient evidence.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted inventory, retention policy and test notes

Procedure: Inspect relevant public transmission paths, approved crypto standard, TLS configuration and validation evidence.
Expected Result: Applicable transmission paths meet current requirements.
Exception Criteria: Weak or unsupported configuration, missing coverage or insufficient evidence.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted endpoint/configuration evidence and review notes

Procedure: Reconcile asset inventory with required protection coverage; inspect update, alert and response samples.
Expected Result: Applicable in-scope systems have required protections and evidence of maintenance/response.
Exception Criteria: Uncovered applicable asset, stale protection or unhandled material alert.
Evidence to Retain: Coverage report and redacted alert/ticket evidence

Procedure: Sample vulnerabilities and software changes; trace identification, risk decision, approval, fix, retest and closure.
Expected Result: Applicable vulnerability and change controls are evidenced end-to-end.
Exception Criteria: Overdue unresolved material issue, unapproved change or unsupported closure.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted tickets, code review and retest references

Procedure: Sample identities and roles; compare access to job need, approval and periodic review; inspect removal of unnecessary rights.
Expected Result: Access is restricted according to applicable business need and documented controls.
Exception Criteria: Excess or unapproved access, missing owner or overdue access removal.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted access matrix, approvals and review record

Procedure: Trace applicable human and non-human access paths; inspect unique identification, authentication and MFA evidence against the exact applicable requirements.
Expected Result: Authentication controls meet the applicable requirement criteria.
Exception Criteria: Shared/unaccountable identities or an authentication/MFA deficiency where required.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted configuration and sample test records

Procedure: Confirm physical scope; inspect authorization, visitor handling, badge reviews and relevant media controls.
Expected Result: Applicable physical access requirements are implemented and evidenced.
Exception Criteria: Unapproved physical access or missing required evidence.
Evidence to Retain: Policy, redacted logs and review notes

Procedure: Inspect required log sources, protection, review records, time synchronization and incident/alert samples.
Expected Result: Required logging, protection, review and response criteria are met.
Exception Criteria: Required events absent, logs inadequately protected or required review unsupported.
Evidence to Retain: Log-source matrix, redacted settings and ticket references

Procedure: Inspect applicable vulnerability scans, penetration tests, segmentation testing, test scope, dates, findings and retest evidence.
Expected Result: Required tests are performed at applicable intervals and findings are addressed.
Exception Criteria: Missing/overdue applicable test, inadequate scope or unresolved finding without disposition.
Evidence to Retain: Authorized test report metadata, findings and retest evidence

Test Objective: Assess security governance and service-provider oversight
Procedure: Sample policy reviews, risk assessments, awareness, incident response tests, provider register and responsibility evidence.
Expected Result: Applicable governance and provider oversight requirements are evidenced.
Exception Criteria: Missing accountability, stale provider evidence or undocumented responsibility gap.
Evidence to Retain: Approved policy metadata, provider records and review notes

Procedure: Sample closed gaps and trace requirement, fix, evidence, retest result, residual-risk decision and approver.
Expected Result: Closure is supported by sufficient evidence and authorized review.
Exception Criteria: Ticket marked closed without retest or required approval.
Evidence to Retain: Redacted closure evidence and approval reference
